## Need

Describe the concrete use case and who needs it. Identify the roadmap phase;
do not assume a runtime, provider or game integration already exists.

## Proposed scope

Describe the smallest useful change, its inputs and outputs, and what remains
deferred. Mention dependencies, trust boundaries and data/rights concerns.

## Contract and decision effects

Identify affected schemas, versions, compatibility notes and any ADR needed.
Keep proposals distinct from accepted decisions. List alternatives or open
questions that could change the choice.

## Evidence of completion

Describe how the result could be checked locally with original synthetic data.
Changes to remote execution, publishing or deployment need a separate owner
decision under docs/deployment.md.
